subject: [PATCH 6/6] NFSD: Document how to choose an IO mode

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch adds documentation to help administrators choose the correct IO mode for an NFS export, including when to use buffered, dontcache, or direct IO. It explains why a low server page cache hit rate is normal and lists workload conditions that favor each IO mode. The documentation also describes existing metrics to measure performance, such as per-export miss ratio from export_stats and client mountstats byte counters.
